==Usage instructions==
<pre>{{ReferenceBook
|image=
|title=
|author=
|cover artist=
|illustrator=
|editor=
|publisher=
|release date=
|other date=
|type=
|pages=
|dimensions=
|weight=
|isbn=
|isbn2=
|isbn3=
|isbn4=
|isbn5=
|series=
|preceded by=
|followed by=
}}</pre>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|image}} Use the book's front cover.
*{{Para|book name}} Use the official full name of the book as published.
*{{Para|author}} Include the name of the author(s).
*{{Para|cover artist}} Include the name of the cover artist(s).
*{{Para|illustrator}} Include the name of the illustrator(s).
*{{Para|editor}} Include the name of the editor(s).
*{{Para|publisher}} Include the name of the publisher(s).
*{{Para|release date}} Include the date in which the book was released.
*{{Para|type}} Specify if its <code>hardcover</code>, <code>paperback</code>, and/or <code>eBook</code>.
*{{Para|pages}} Include the number of pages.
*{{Para|isbn}} Use the book's [[Wikipedia:International Standard Book Number|ISBN]], which will automatically create a link to [[Special:Booksources]]. If no ISBNs are available, use <code>none</code>.
*{{Para|series}} Include the series the book may be part of.
*{{Para|preceded by}} Include the preceding book in the series.
*{{Para|followed by}} Include the subsequent book in the series.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|isbn2}} As per {{Para|isbn}}, but for a second ISBN, if available. Leave the parameter blank if not required.
*{{Para|isbn3}} As per {{Para|isbn}}, but for a third ISBN, if available. Leave the parameter blank if not required.
*{{Para|isbn4}} As per {{Para|isbn}}, but for a fourth ISBN if available. Leave the parameter blank if not required.
*{{Para|isbn5}} As per {{Para|isbn}}, but for a fifth ISBN if available. Leave the parameter blank if not required.
